title: MIDAS RIN List Entry
description: A RIN entry returned by the SignalType query.

Description.description: Human-readable description including distribution and energy providers.

LastUpdated.description: Timestamp of the last update to this RIN's data (UTC). On live v2.0 it carries a basic-format UTC offset (±HHMM, e.g. '+0000', no colon), confirmed 2026-06-22 — resolving the v1.0 bare/zoneless form. Note: '+0000' is ISO 8601 but not RFC 3339, so strict RFC-3339 parsers (e.g. Java ISO_OFFSET_DATE_TIME, which requires '+00:00') reject it; parse with a lenient formatter accepting '+0000', '+00:00', and 'Z'. The pattern here intentionally accepts the bare, basic-offset, extended-offset, and 'Z' forms.
